newsitem.title: FRANCE: First day of Algeria political conference ends.
newsitem.headline: First day of Algeria political conference ends.

text.p: Algeria's leadership and about 1,000 politicians on Saturday closed the first day of a two-day conference aimed at ending nearly five years of violence in which about 50,000 people have been killed.

They will resume on Sunday to adopt a platform to underline Algerian President Liamine Zeroual's aim to establish a multi-party democracy from which radical Islamists would banned, the official Algerian news agency APS reported.

Zeroual, who is chairing the conference, opened it by urging politicians to back his plan to pave the way for stable democracy shielding the North African gas and oil producing country from more threats from Moslem fundamentalists.
The authorities have blamed the violence on Moslem fundamentalists and are seeking a consensus for political reform. The disputed conference is being boycotted by the main secular opposition.
